brDoc.para: These business rules apply to all data modules of the project.

brLevelledPara.title: Naming rules
brLevelledPara.para: Data module codes shall follow the project SNS.

note.notePara: Rules are checked by the project BREX.

brLevelledPara.title: Titles
brLevelledPara.para: Technical names are in sentence case.

brLevelledPara.title: Security
brLevelledPara.para: All data modules are unclassified unless stated.
